evals.name: monthly-pulse-run
evals.prompt: Run this month's SEO pulse for internal-agents.com and give me the report.
evals.expected_output: Builds the site, runs the volumes, rank, and tech-audit scripts from the repository root, reads their summaries, adds drift notes, and writes docs/seo/pulse-YYYY-MM.md with the SKILL.md template. Reports the search-performance phase as skipped when no Search Console export is available. Handles missing DataForSEO credentials or an empty balance by saying which phases are incomplete instead of inventing numbers.

evals.name: template-defect-attribution
evals.prompt: The organization pages look weak in search. What is wrong with them?
evals.expected_output: Runs tech-audit.mjs (building dist first, or with --live) and reports the organization family defects: the description of 47 characters on all 35 pages and the missing BreadcrumbList node. Names src/pages/organizations/[id].astro as the single template fix rather than listing 35 pages, and says the short page text is answered by more records for that organization, not by more words.

evals.name: demand-without-evidence
evals.prompt: "ai agent pricing comparison" gets a lot of searches. Can we make a page for it?
evals.expected_output: Declines to propose a page the catalog cannot support with sources, citing the inclusion rules in CONTRIBUTING.md, and explains that evidence decides what gets built. Offers the supported alternative: an existing record or note that answers part of the question, or a research lead recorded in docs/coverage-backlog.md with its source.

evals.name: config-maintenance
evals.prompt: Track 'ai agent evaluation harness' and 'plaid ai agent', and check their volume.
evals.expected_output: Adds both terms to tracked_keywords in .claude/skills/seo/config.json, adds only the ownable one ('plaid ai agent', an organization with a record) to rank_keywords, then runs dfs-volumes.mjs and reports the volume and cost per click. Keeps the existing configuration and its comments intact.

evals.name: partial-run-safety
evals.prompt: Just check the note pages for SEO problems, do not touch anything else.
evals.expected_output: Runs tech-audit.mjs --family note and reports the note defects (the short descriptions on three notes and the 73-character title on /notes/work-can-continue). States that the run wrote no snapshot, because a run of one family would replace the baseline of the month.

evals.name: queries-export-discovery
evals.prompt: Here is our Search Console queries export. What should we work on first?
evals.expected_output: Runs gsc-queries.mjs on the file, reports brand share separately from subject searches, lists the striking-distance queries (position 5 to 20 with impressions) with the page and the title change each one suggests, and lists the untracked queries to add to config.json. Does not propose a new page for a query the catalog has no record for.

evals.name: keywords-follow-the-catalog
evals.prompt: We added five new records this month. Is the keyword tracking still current?
evals.expected_output: Runs catalog-terms.mjs --untracked, names the new records whose organization-plus-system terms nobody tracks, adds the ones with a searchable name to rank_keywords, and skips generic names such as 'internal coding agent' with the reason.
